reason: සස්සුදෙවා is the woman who holds her mother-in-law as a deity (BJT: “නැදිමයිලන් දෙවි කොට වෙසෙන”); the Sinhala turns it round and makes the woman like a goddess to her mother-in-law.
The Pāli particle ඛො stands in the Sinhala sentence (“ආනන්දය, මෙසේ ඛො භික්ෂුව …”). Taken out, nothing else changed.

සතං සතසහස්සානං is a hundred hundred-thousands (BJT: “සියක්ලක්‍ෂයෙකි”); the Sinhala has one hundred-thousand (“ලක්ෂයකි”). Written on the pattern of the twin sentence of the sutta before it (18:0, “අසූ ලක්ෂයකි”).
